Your AI can go through a product export and draft clearer titles and descriptions before ChatGPT Ads use them.

UK Shopify brands can now buy ads in ChatGPT from inside Shopify. Two details matter before you test it.

The ads only reach people on ChatGPT's Free and Go plans. If you sell to senior buyers on a paid plan at work, they won't see them. And OpenAI says ads never influence the answers, so buying ads won't get your products recommended. Paid and organic stay separate efforts.

What links them is the catalogue. The ads draw on your Shopify product titles, descriptions, images and prices. Give your AI a product export for your test category and it flags what's thin or inconsistent and drafts better titles and descriptions for your team to approve.

clips.text: Who actually sees these ads? Only people on ChatGPT's Free and Go plans. Plus, Pro and Enterprise stay ad-free. For a consumer brand that's most shoppers. But if you sell to senior buyers using a paid plan at work, the ads won't reach them at all. And for them the only way in is still being the source ChatGPT cites. OpenAI also says ads never influence the answers. So buying ads won't get your products recommended in the answer itself. So paid and organic run as separate efforts, even though they sit on the same screen.

clips.linkedin:
Your AI can go through a product export and draft clearer titles and descriptions before ChatGPT Ads use them.

ChatGPT Ads on Shopify draw on whatever's in your catalogue, so product titles, descriptions, images and prices are doing the job ad creative used to do. A thin catalogue now costs you twice, in the paid channel and in organic AI answers.

Before a test, give your AI a product export for the category you're testing. It flags what's thin or inconsistent and drafts better titles and descriptions for your team to approve.

If you try the optional setting that rewrites your headlines, paste the rewrites in alongside your brand guidelines. It tells you line by line which ones change a claim, drift from your tone or mistranslate.

The prompts are in the show notes.

The podcast voices are AI-generated. Full episode and article at https://manual-focus.co.uk/blog/chatgpt-ads-shopify-uk-ecommerce/
clips.text: Get AI on this. First job, tidy the catalogue for the category you're testing. Give it a product export for that category and it goes through every title, description and image description, flags what's thin or inconsistent, and drafts better titles and descriptions for your team to approve before anything changes in Shopify. Second, get your AI to read the automatic copy. Paste in the rewritten headlines from the test ad group alongside your brand guidelines. It tells you which ones change a claim, drift from your tone or mistranslate, line by line.
